title: Maegu Infinite Combo
subtitle: Succession · loopable grind combo
notes: A 'new/lazy, tanky-spot' loop — move to the DPS-priority playstyle once comfortable.
Optional steps only pay off with high attack speed (BSR / Shai buffs) — skip them otherwise.
Starters and finishers are pick-one: the options do similar damage, so choose by which movement fits the pull.

extras.title: Reposition — Lurking Claws
extras.text: Slot in anywhere for back-attacks — EXCEPT between Spirited Away and Petal Play.

extras.title: Out of spells — Constricting Charm to Spirit Sparks
extras.text: Extra filler if you run dry before the loop comes back around.
